analysis.aggregate: median of paired effects; min/max describe observed pairs, not confidence intervals
analysis.improvement_pct: 100 * (1 - EXP-003 process median / EXP-002 process median)
analysis.speedup: EXP-002 process median / EXP-003 process median
analysis.unit_of_comparison: matched process pair; inner observations are not independent experiments

interpretation.encapsulation_decapsulation: All 30 pairs are positive; median reductions range from 4.298095441900274 to 4.9777498387070125 percent. Both order-group medians are positive in every parameter/operation group.
interpretation.keygen: Kyber512 has four negative and one positive pair (median -0.3124 percent), Kyber768 all five negative (median -0.5132 percent), and Kyber1024 all five positive (median +0.7039 percent). These are retained observations. No inverse transform is called by keygen, so its movement is not attributable to saved inverse Barrett calls. The two inspected key-generation entry points have unchanged normalised instructions and entry locations. Changes elsewhere in binary layout and environment/noise are possible contributors, but the separate causes are not identified.
interpretation.mechanism: Prior counts establish 896 to 128 Barrett calls per inverse transform and unchanged Montgomery calls. New timing binaries match reviewed invntt/reducers. Larger code, smaller local stack and split-loop/layout changes accompany reduction savings; their individual timing contributions are not isolated.
interpretation.next: I propose a distinct EXP-005 error-vector post-NTT reduction deferral on top of retained EXP-003, with a new caller/range argument, exact manual call-site change and validation gates before timing. EXP-004 remains deferred for a separate interaction/combination question.
interpretation.order_and_variation: Odd blocks favour EXP-002 first and even blocks EXP-003 first, a three-versus-two split. Order-group medians differ; the small groups do not establish order independence. Kyber768 candidate block 4 has higher medians across all three operations, reducing that pair benefit; it is retained without exclusion. All raw extremes remain included in the process medians.
interpretation.retention: I retain EXP-003 as the next research reference for its consistent encapsulation/decapsulation gains, while preserving the observed key-generation tradeoffs. This is not an across-the-board or universal speedup.
interpretation.scope: One session, five process pairs per parameter, repeated public fixtures, one compiler/WSL target; no confidence interval, formal significance or cross-platform guarantee. Do not treat 90000 durations as independent experiments or combine separate-run medians into a cumulative original-reference gain.
interpretation.security: The earlier centred-input bounds, exact sampled normal/UBSan transcripts and scoped public-control-flow assembly findings remain applicable through identical source/function hashes. No new leakage test or whole-program proof was run. EXP-003 removes no inverse-function canary; the earlier EXP-002 dot-function hardening tradeoff remains. Speed does not establish constant-time security, memory safety, final ML-KEM conformance or production approval.

protocol.order: block, then 512/768/1024; adjacent variant pairs; EXP-002 first in odd blocks
